title: Shared subprocess/toolchain/command-invocation helper family
problemStatement: Windows wrapper resolution, PATH-backed command shim lookup, and command/env normalization were duplicated across tooling probes, installer paths, setup/bootstrap, SourceKit preflight, and VS Code packaging checks. Those surfaces were all deciding independently how to launch bare commands like npm and other wrapper-backed tools.

duplicateClusters.name: Shared tooling subprocess helpers plus local wrapper logic
duplicateClusters.bestFix: Hoist command invocation and wrapper normalization into src/shared/subprocess/command-invocation.js, then make tooling callers consume the shared helper instead of maintaining local Windows/npm logic.

duplicateClusters.name: Runtime provider probe and preflight wrapper handling
duplicateClusters.bestFix: Replace local shouldUseShell / resolveSpawnCommand branches with the same shared resolved subprocess contract used by tooling surfaces.

duplicateClusters.name: Package-script-specific command probes
duplicateClusters.bestFix: Use the shared probe surface instead of bespoke npm probing so packaging checks stay aligned with the rest of the repo.

whyCurrentSharedModulesWereInsufficient: src/shared/subprocess.js owned low-level process execution, but not wrapper-aware command normalization.
src/shared/subprocess/windows-cmd.js exposed Windows-specific primitives, but each caller still had to decide when and how to use them.
tools/shared/cli-utils.js normalized results, but did not serve as the canonical owner for src/** runtime call sites.

migrationsCompleted.notes: Now owns wrapper-aware command resolution and sync/async resolved subprocess execution.
Uses the shared resolved subprocess helper for command execution.
Command probe execution no longer carries local Windows shim handling.
SourceKit preflight uses the shared async resolved subprocess helper.
JSON child streaming now uses the shared resolved subprocess helper instead of a local npm branch.
Local Windows wrapper path resolution was removed.
Uses the shared command probe surface instead of bespoke npm probing.

nonGoals: Move install-plan selection or package manifest validation into src/shared in this issue.
Replace every remaining subprocess wrapper in the codebase in one pass.
Unify higher-level retry/reporting semantics for all toolchain operations.
followOnDeletionTargets: Any remaining local wrapper-resolution branches found in later H31/H32 scans.
Potential future consolidation of structured toolchain probe/report envelopes once more callers are migrated.
